card.name: Words just before a named condition
card.fires_on: Linking words like "with" or "in" after "patients", and "underlying" before "disease", in drug-label text. The next word is expected to name a disease or medical condition.

modes.label: Patients with / in
modes.description: "with" or "in" after patients or a population, where a disease name comes next.
modes.example: Sudden death has been reported in association with CNS stimulant treatment at usual doses in pediatric patients<< with>> structural cardiac abnormalities

modes.label: Underlying disease
modes.description: The word "underlying" after "the contribution of the", ahead of "disease".
modes.example: The contribution of the<< underlying>> disease and/or prior corticosteroid

card.writes: It promotes disease and illness words and so makes a condition name likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on small words that signal a disease or condition is about to be named, such as "patients with".
